$comment: Seconds each browser test file runs in one of CI's docs browser jobs (4 cores, the files several at a time, so the time a file takes beside others): what packages/tools/src/run-node-tests.js splits the files into TEST_SHARD's shares by (`--shard-weights`, apps/docs/package.json's test:browser), longest first, each to the share with the least so far. A file not named here weighs the median of these, and the log of its job says so. A name of a file that is not here is ignored. Measured again from CI runs 42696507478 and 42708250670 (2026-11-09, each job's `# file-duration` lines, both at main's tree), the mean of the two. Keep them current: a file they do not weigh, or weigh at half its time, lands in a job it overfills. To measure them again: every job sharded by these weights prints `# file-duration <file> <seconds>` (the duration of the file's own run) at the end of its log; save the logs of a run's jobs (`gh run view <run> --job <job> --log > shard-N.log`) and run `node packages/tools/src/shard-weights.js apps/docs/test/browser/durations.json shard-1.log shard-2.log shard-3.log`. `$alone` lists the files that take a CI job of their own (packages/tools/src/run-node-tests.js, balance): the fixture gallery keeps the job's cores busy for its whole run, and beside it the Button page took more than 30 s to load in WebKit (run 40329390452), so it runs alone and the others share the remaining jobs. The two previews files run alone for the same reason: each draws four pages at a time in Chromium, rastered on the CPU, for its whole run, and beside either one the Button page took 20 to 35 s to load in WebKit and Firefox, often more than `goto`'s 30 s (the Do and Don't, appearance and one-frame tests, in CI and in the CI image). The icon font's test runs alone for the same reason: it opens every built page, four at a time in Chromium, for its whole run, and beside it the Button page took 20 to 32 s to load in WebKit in CI (its share of runs 42696507478, 42708250670 and 42741065358, the last over `goto`'s 30 s); in the CI image on 2 CPUs, its share's files, run as CI runs them, failed 5 to 10 tests in each of 5 runs, the Button page taking 24 to 36 s in WebKit; without it, its other files (once) and the shares the page foot's test has had since (four runs) failed none but the sitemap's test, which dates pages by a commit history the image's copy does not have, the Button page taking 8 to 16 s. The reader's own theme runs alone for the other side of it: it measures how soon a press is drawn (150 ms), and beside other files WebKit drew it in 170 to 210 ms (CI run 42752233102; the CI image on 2 CPUs, three runs of four, two files at a time as well as three), where alone it drew it in 36 to 55 ms (the CI image, five runs measured, and none of eight runs alone failed).
